registration_note: Central pre-result proposal; requires explicit operator ratification before any holdout scoring

definitions.candidate_recall: selected high-value events divided by all adjudicated high-value source events
definitions.durable_grounded_precision: human-judged supported/authority-correct/scope-correct persisted facts divided by adjudicated facts
definitions.semantic_recall: source-correct answers containing expected graph context in genuinely new installed native sessions
definitions.context_p95_ms_max: observed 95th percentile of interactive context injection, bounded by existing 300ms control
definitions.post_exit_p95_seconds_max: measured post-exit admission through positive terminal Graphiti readback; unresolved sessions separately reported
definitions.safety: Zero observed secret exposure, wrong-group citation, upgraded verified claims or blind Graphiti submission replay

notes: Not a human-adjudicated corpus or an accepted holdout result.
No baseline thresholds are revised in response to holdout outcomes.
